title: Be approved as a cemetery manager
what: Manage a cemetery only as its approved (or deemed) cemetery manager.

sources.title: Burial and Cremation Act 2019 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not manage a cemetery unless – (a) the person has been approved under this section to be the cemetery manager for the cemetery;
